content:
Tenable's PCI ASV streamlines the quarterly external vulnerability scan submission and dispute
process as required by PCI 11.2.2. With pre-configured scan templates and an efficient
evidence/dispute resolution process, Tenable (an Approved Scanning Vendor) can quickly prepare a
compliant scan report for merchants and service providers. You can use the PCI ASV API to retrieve a
list of PCI ASV scans.
